description: This file defines the main Backbone.js view for a Todo application, managing UI interactions, rendering, and collection event bindings.

classes.name: AppView
classes.description: Main Backbone view managing the Todo app UI, events, and collection interactions.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Sets up DOM element references, binds collection events, and fetches initial data.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Updates the UI to reflect the current state of the Todo collection, including stats and filters.

methods.name: addOne
methods.description: Creates and appends a view for a single Todo model.

methods.name: addAll
methods.description: Clears and repopulates the Todo list with all models.

methods.name: filterOne
methods.description: Triggers visibility update for a single Todo item.

methods.name: filterAll
methods.description: Applies filtering to all Todo items.

methods.name: newAttributes
methods.description: Generates attributes for a new Todo model based on input.

methods.name: createOnEnter
methods.description: Creates a new Todo model when Enter key is pressed and input is valid.

methods.name: toggleAllComplete
methods.description: Sets all Todo models to completed or not based on the toggle checkbox.
